utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon. Mr. Registrar, would you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Good afternoon to everyone in the courtroom. This is the case number IT-04-84-A, The Prosecutor versus Ramush Haradinaj et al.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: I thank you. May I now please have the appearances of the parties, for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. KREMER
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. President. Peter Kremer appearing on behalf of the Prosecution. I'm assisted by Marwan Dalal, and our Case Manager, Ms. Alma Imamovic-Ivanov.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: I thank you. Now for the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. DIXON
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Rodney Dixon appearing on behalf of Mr. Ramush Haradinaj. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MS. ROHAN
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Colleen Rohan appearing on behalf of Idriz Balaj.

utterances.speaker: MR. HARVEY
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Richard Harvey appearing on behalf of Lahi Brahimaj.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: I thank you. Now, may I ask Mr. Brahimaj if can he hear and follow the proceedings in a language he understands. THE APPELLANT BRAHIMAJ: [Interpretation] Yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: I thank you. So this Status Conference is called in accordance with Rule 65 bis of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence. The previous Status Conference in the present case was held on 24 November 2008. The -- as you know, the parties know the purpose of the Status Conference is to allow any person in custody, pending appeal, the opportunity to raise issues in relation to their detention, including the health conditions of the person detained. I would, therefore, like to inquire about Mr. Brahimaj's state of health and conditions of detention, and perhaps Mr. Brahimaj himself would tell us if he has any concerns in relation to the detention conditions or his state of health. So I would invite you, Mr. Brahimaj, to raise any issue you want to raise in this context now. I wish to remind you that depending on the issues, if any, that you want to raise, you need a private session, please ask it before you raise the issues that should be dealt with in private session. Please, Mr. Brahimaj. THE APPELLANT BRAHIMAJ: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honour. I don't have any concerns or worries.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: I thank you very much. Let me now come into the procedural history of this case. Let me recall that the briefings, as to the appeals of the Prosecution and Mr. Brahimaj, are complete. So I don't want to go back to the filings that have been made. As to the date where the case will be heard, I wish to let the parties know that, for the time being, due to the schedule of the Appeals Chamber, there will be no possibility of scheduling hearing prior to the month of May, but as soon as we will be able to make a decision it will be communicated to the parties in order that they have the time to prepare for the hearing with the -- so they will know well in advance when the hearing is scheduled. At this point, I don't have any other issue to discuss here, so I would like to ask the parties if they want to raise any issue concerning the case at this point. Prosecution?

utterances.speaker: MR. KREMER
utterances.text: No, Your Honour, other than the fact --

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. KREMER
utterances.text: The hearing date is going to be considered, and perhaps the Court could consult with the parties, I know Mr. Dixon addressed this with me before the hearing, just to make sure that we're all available. The Prosecution is captive in the institution, but I know counsel from private practice or with other cases may have some difficulty in being available without prior consultation. So I raise that on behalf of all counsel.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Well, Mr. Kremer, we will take in due consideration this comment you have made and certainly we will consult in order to set an appropriate date for all the parties. Is the Defence wishing to raise any other issue.

utterances.speaker: MR. DIXON
utterances.text: Your Honour, thank you for giving that indication about informal consultations. It will certainly assist. Of course, we are in the hands of the Court, but if there can be informal consultations prior to any fixed date, that would be of immeasurable assistance. If I could also just clarify, if I may, Your Honour, about the -- the date. Are we to understand that the month of May will not be considered as a time when the appeal could be heard; in other words, that the first possibility would be after the end of the month of May commencing in June? If I may find out.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Well, I said it could be May at the earliest, but, of course, we will consult before setting a date.

utterances.speaker: MR. DIXON
utterances.text: I'm grateful. Thank you, Your Honour. That's all I have to raise on behalf of Mr. Haradinaj today.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MS. ROHAN
utterances.text: Thank you. There is no issues to raise on behalf of Mr. Balaj. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. HARVEY
utterances.text: Your Honour, on behalf of Lahi Brahimaj, I should just add this, thanking also Mr. Kremer and Mr. Dixon for their comments about consultation with the private bar. It is most helpful when -- for those of us in busy practices elsewhere. I would be remiss if I did not draw to Your Honour's attention today the fact that we have prepared for immediate filing an application for provisional release of Mr. Brahimaj pending the hearing of the appeal. I have notified the Prosecution of that informally, and those papers should be filed within the next day or two. I'm just awaiting the receipt of guarantors from Kosovo where he would be seeking to return, which those -- those guarantors' papers should be with me shortly and that application, therefore, will be filed very soon.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: I thank you for this indication and, of course, the Appeals Chamber will deal with the application as soon as the motion will be filed.

utterances.speaker: MR. HARVEY
utterances.text: I'm most grateful. Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you. I believe that this concludes our business today. So I thank the parties for their attendance and call this hearing to a close.
